### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of scrambled eggs, roasted potato pieces, leafy salad with cucumber and strawberries, and pineapple chunks. A little sauce and a glossy dressing are visible.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Food identification and pile heights are approximate. Dressing is counted separately from the foods it coats.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density (g/ml) | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leafy greens | 28% | 149 × 2.8 = 417 ml | 0.15 | 62 g | 20 | 12 kcal |
| Scrambled eggs | 14% | 74 × 1.5 = 111 ml | 0.95 | 106 g | 160 | 170 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 18% | 96 × 2.2 = 211 ml | 0.60 | 126 g | 150 | 189 kcal |
| Pineapple chunks | 9% | 48 × 2.2 = 106 ml | 0.60 | 63 g | 50 | 32 kcal |
| Strawberry pieces | 5% | 27 × 1.8 = 49 ml | 0.60 | 29 g | 32 | 9 kcal |
| Likely cucumber slices | 3% | 16 × 1.5 = 24 ml | 0.60 | 14 g | 15 | 2 kcal |
| Sauce on eggs | 1% | 5 × 1.0 = 5 ml | 1.0 | 5 g | 100 | 5 kcal |
| Oil-based salad dressing | Overlay | 150 × 0.04 = 6 ml | ≈1.0 | 6 g | 800 | 48 kcal |

**Area check:** 28 + 14 + 18 + 9 + 5 + 3 + 1 = **78% covered**. Dressing overlaps the salad, so it adds no new footprint. Potato and egg energy values include their estimated cooking fat.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **410 g and 470 kcal** is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate. The greens occupy substantial space but weigh only about 62 g; eggs and potatoes account for most of the energy.
